captions.detailed: This 3D model consists of two separate rectangular parts: a tall main card box body and a shorter matching lid. The main body has thin outer walls, a hollow interior designed to hold cards, and a stepped rim at the top to receive the lid. One side of the main body features a subtle, vertically oriented stylized line pattern. The lid is a simple hollow rectangular cap designed to slide snugly onto the stepped rim of the main box.
captions.instruction: Design a parametric card case with a separate lid in OpenSCAD. The script should allow users to adjust the capacity of the box using a card count parameter, choose between business card and playing card dimensions, and optionally place custom text or stenciled images on the outer face of the box.
captions.factory: The code defines two primary modules: 'box_lid' and 'box'. The 'box_lid' module uses a subtraction of nested cubes to create a hollow rectangular cap with a stepped shelf. The 'box' module uses nested cubes to construct the main hollow container, subtracting a scaled 'box_lid' from the top to form the mating lip. Custom text is integrated using the 'write' library, and stencil patterns are projected onto the box face using translated, rotated, and scaled 2D polygon paths.
